Готово. Все 16 тестов проходят, оба пакета анализируются без ошибок.

## Что сделано

### 1) Типы ошибок и их использование в usecase

**`ExportErrorType`** ([export_usecase.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/domain/usecase/export_usecase.dart)): `noNotes`, `encryptionFailed`, `fileWriteFailed`, `unknown`.

**`ImportErrorType`** ([import_usecase.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/domain/usecase/import_usecase.dart)): `invalidFile`, `wrongPassword`, `notAuthenticated`, `unknown`.

**[export_usecase_impl.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/data/export_usecase_impl.dart)** — обёрнуты этапы:
- шифрование → `ExportError(encryptionFailed)`;
- запись/zip файла (включая пустой zip) → `ExportError(fileWriteFailed)`;
- всё остальное → `ExportError(unknown)` (через `on ExportError { rethrow; }`).
- Пустое хранилище по-прежнему возвращает `''` (контракт сохранён, тест не сломан) — `noNotes` поднимается на уровне блока.

**[import_usecase_impl.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/data/import_usecase_impl.dart)**:
- `_readFile` теперь бросает `ImportError(invalidFile)` (нет файла / не zip / нет json / неверная версия / повреждение) и возвращает non-null;
- нет приватного ключа → `ImportError(notAuthenticated)`;
- деривация ключа + расшифровка → `ImportError(wrongPassword)`;
- этап записи в стор/outbox → `ImportError(unknown)`.

### 2) Обработка в экране + локализация

- [export_import_screen.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/presentation/settings/export_import/export_import_screen.dart): `messageBuilder` через `_errorMessage(...)` маппит `ExportError`/`ImportError` по `payload` в локализованные строки; для `unknown` возвращает `null` → `showError` подставляет дефолтное «Something went wrong».
- Блок ([export_import_bloc.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/presentation/settings/export_import/bloc/export_import_bloc.dart)) при пустом пути отдаёт `ExportError(noNotes)` вместо тихого idle.

12	
13	/// Resolves a per-note import collision: when a backup note shares its d-tag
14	/// (`kind:pubkey:d-tag` coordinate) with an already stored note, the policy
15	/// produces the single resulting note for that d-tag.
16	///
17	/// The result always keeps the original d-tag, so the event store replaces the
18	/// stored version natively via addressable-event (NIP-33) semantics — no relay
19	/// deletion is involved. When there is no collision ([existing] is `null`)
20	/// every policy returns the incoming note unchanged.
21	sealed class ImportPolicy {
22	  const ImportPolicy();
23	
24	  /// Combine both notes: keep the existing content and append the imported one
25	  /// (labels from both are merged).
26	  const factory ImportPolicy.mergeContent() = MergeContent;
27	
28	  /// On collision the imported note wins (overwrites the stored one).
29	  const factory ImportPolicy.keepIncoming() = KeepIncoming;
30	
31	  /// On collision the stored note wins (the imported one is dropped).
32	  const factory ImportPolicy.keepExisting() = KeepExisting;
33	
34	  Note apply(Note incoming, Note? existing);
35	}
36	
37	final class MergeContent extends ImportPolicy {
38	  const MergeContent();
39	
40	  static const separator = '\n\n------ Imported ------\n\n';
41	
42	  @override
43	  Note apply(Note incoming, Note? existing) {
44	    if (existing == null) {
45	      return incoming;
46	    }
47	    return incoming.copyWith(
48	      content: '${existing.content}$separator${incoming.content}',
49	      labels: {...existing.labels, ...incoming.labels}.toList(),
50	    );
51	  }
52	}
53	
54	final class KeepIncoming extends ImportPolicy {
55	  const KeepIncoming();
56	
57	  @override
58	  Note apply(Note incoming, Note? existing) => incoming;
59	}
60	
61	final class KeepExisting extends ImportPolicy {
62	  const KeepExisting();
63	
64	  @override
65	  Note apply(Note incoming, Note? existing) => existing ?? incoming;
66	}
67	
68	final class ImportError extends CustomError<ImportErrorType> {
69	  const ImportError({required super.payload, super.parentError, super.reason});
70	}
71	
72	enum ImportErrorType {
73	  /// The file is missing, not a valid archive, or has an unsupported version.
74	  invalidFile,
75	
76	  /// Decryption failed — wrong password or the backup is corrupted.
77	  wrongPassword,
78	
79	  /// No unlocked session is available to re-encrypt the imported notes.
80	  notAuthenticated,

---

## Solution

`file_picker ^12.0.0-0` (pinned to `12.0.0-beta.5`) is the answer to all three problems simultaneously:

| Problem | 3.0.4 | 10.x | **12.0.0-beta.5** |
|---|---|---|---|
| win32 conflict with share_plus 13 | ✅ (no win32 dep at all) | ❌ win32 ^5.9.0 | ✅ win32 ^6.2.0 |
| iOS Swift Package Manager | ❌ CocoaPods-only | ❌ CocoaPods-only | ✅ `sharedDarwinSource: true` |
| Flutter 3.44.0 compatible | ⚠️ very old | ✅ | ✅ requires ≥3.38.0 |

**Why 12.x works**: The `<12.0.0-beta.1` boundary in the resolver message is exactly where the author switched from `win32 ^5.9.0` to `^6.2.0` and rewrote the iOS/macOS native layer as a `darwin/` shared SPM package instead of separate CocoaPods podspecs. After `pub get`, Flutter confirms: **"All plugins found for ios are Swift Packages"**.

**One caveat**: the constraint `^12.0.0-0` permits pre-release versions. Once 12.x goes stable you can tighten it to `^12.0.0`.
